notes.title: 1.3: Bug fixes and a pause screen
notes.notes:
This is a small update with a few bug fixes, such as one where the right-click UI element didn't appear 🖱

We also added a (slooooooooo mooooooo 🐢) pause screen that appears when you hit ESC:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38189095/e9f2ce393e1bc8eb63fe0c77a95f60a4b25b1b47.png[/img]

Turtles are cool.. I kind of want to add a turtle now.. 🐢

notes.title: 1.1: Bug fixes!
notes.notes:
These are the bugs fixed in this release:

[list]
[*] Bug where the UI didn't work in some resolutions such as 1366x768
[*] Bug where you could put friends into walls/rocks.. Hey, that's not cool. ⛔
[*] Magical teleporting fox bug 🧙‍♂️🦊
[*] Spinning cable car bug 🤢
[*] Adjusted the jumpscare inducing victory fanfare 😱
[/list]

A big thanks to everyone who let us know about these bugs 🙏

See you on the other side of the mountain!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38189095/a405c82fa34d9ceab6457abf523ec63d84749b6b.gif[/img]
